cyberattack: Other: Source/configuration-file probing; no disclosure established
data.description:
The archive preserves requests for .git/config, tseries_ajax.php.bak and an encoded parent-path variant ending tseries_ajax.phps. All three representative responses are verified 404s. An additional ?.phps query returned an empty body rather than PHP source. These requests support source/configuration-file probing, distinct from the XSS tests, but do not establish source disclosure, successful traversal or a particular requester. The target is the University of Maine Climate Reanalyzer service.

Internal company attribution review (2026-09-28): OpenAI — low confidence. Nearby captured Microlink climate-retrieval programs in the June 19-21 window use OpenAI-suggestive output names oaimg1781984054 and oai_func_1781984697 while targeting the same Climate Reanalyzer monthly time-series workflow. This is a weak company-specific lead, so OpenAI is retained as a low-confidence internal hypothesis for follow-up. These names are not authenticated identities, and no program identifier, wiki post or requester trace links those programs directly to this report's probes. The attribution may be wrong; the observed probe outcomes are unchanged. This label is an internal attribution hypothesis, not a confirmed attribution or a publication-ready conclusion.
data.summary: June 19–21 archive captures show requests for Climate Reanalyzer .git/config, a PHP backup and an encoded PHP-source path. The verified responses are 404. Source-file probing is supported; disclosure, successful traversal and AI authorship are unconfirmed.
